text: You’re mistaken, young man. I’ve eaten your mother’s kolaches long before that Easter Day when you were born.’ ‘Always too fresh, Leo,’ Ambrosch remarked with a shrug. Leo dived behind his mother and grinned out at me. We turned to leave the cave; Ántonia and I went up the stairs first, and the children waited. We were standing outside talking, when they all came running up the steps together, big and little, tow heads and gold heads and brown, and flashing little naked legs; a veritable explosion of life out of the dark cave into the sunlight.
